name: Notary's house
description: Notary's villa, 17.2 x 11.2 m, two storeys and an attic, after the reference pack's red-brick villa: brick walls with dressed-stone quoins, plinth and bands, segmental relieving arches and keystones over the windows, louvred green shutters above, a brick cross gable over the entrance with a stone perron and an arched door hood, a square corner tower with a steep slate pyramid, a steep slate roof with finialed dormers and tall stone-capped stacks, ivy. Study, hall and salon; three bedrooms; an attic; two stairs.
